sources.snippet: TensorFlow Lite (TFLite) is an open-source deep learning framework specifically designed for running machine learning models on mobile and edge devices. By exporting your YOLOv10 model to TFLite format, you can optimize your model for low-latency, real-time inference on devices with limited computational resources.
